description: World - Global Tracking Framework is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Energy efficiency", published or maintained by Vivien Foster (World Bank Group). The Global Tracking Framework (GTF) measures how the world is progressing toward Sustainable Energy for All, tracking country-level indicators for energy access, renewable energy and energy efficiency. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 4 files in XLS, CSV. The portal files it under Energy access, Energy efficiency, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
